Marcus Lemonis ( @MarcusLemonisOfficial ) is a business icon, but in this episode, he takes off the mask. We discuss what really happened behind the scenes of The Profit, the IRS audit that followed, and why he says the show "stole a chunk of his life." Marcus opens up about his "debilitating" social anxiety, his regrets about not having children, and the $50 million he lost investing in small businesses. plus, he breaks down his new massive plan for Bed Bath & Beyond and real estate on the blockchain.
